mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.title,a.summary,a.category_id,COALESCE(c.name,'未知分类') AS category_name,a.author_id,a.published_at FROM cms_article a LEFT JOIN cms_category c ON c.id=a.category_id AND c.deleted=0 WHERE a.status='PUBLISHED' AND a.deleted=0 AND a.title LIKE #{titlePattern} ESCAPE '!' AND a.category_id=#{query.categoryId} ORDER BY a.published_at DESC,a.id DESC
SELECT * FROM cms_article WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM cms_article WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_article SET status=#{row.status}, review_comment=#{row.reviewComment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reviewer_id=#{row.reviewerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, reviewed_at=#{row.reviewedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, published_at=#{row.publishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, version=version+1, updated_by=#{row.updatedBy}, updated_at=#{row.updatedAt} WHERE id=#{row.id} AND status=#{previous} AND version=#{row.version} AND deleted=0
